authority_scope: Current governed AOM hierarchy, schema, labels, and material assertions
use_for: Complete closure, impact counts, current relation semantics, and compatibility surface
do_not_use_for: Independent physical, chemical, analytical, or regulatory truth
cohort_conclusion: Use as audited baseline; every proposed change must name affected assertions and preserve stable IDs until approval.

authority_scope: Food objects, independent descriptive facets, physical qualities, processes, and chemical components
use_for: Separating measurable qualities, categorical physical descriptors, processing, and chemical identity
do_not_use_for: Copying inherited hierarchies or assuming exact feed-specific equivalence
cohort_conclusion: Create clear physical-descriptor navigation while keeping presentation, consistency, moisture, process, and composition independent.

use_for: External mappings for carbohydrate, protein, starch, essential oil, and broad lipid identity
do_not_use_for: Feed-material classification, measured composition, or exact equivalence for contextual fat/oil categories
cohort_conclusion: Map exact identities where supported; preserve constituent-qualified labels when bare labels collide with feed-material identities.

use_for: Distinguishing ash measurement residue and moisture condition from chemical identity or form
do_not_use_for: Naming every mineral species or defining product hierarchy
cohort_conclusion: Retire Ash constituent as a category error; use measured ash characteristic and explicit mineral identities instead.

authority_scope: Feed blocks, consumption practice, and feed-material descriptions
use_for: Distinguishing block presentation from lick delivery and validating poultry by-product role
do_not_use_for: Universal exact mapping of every formulation or automatic family-process inheritance
cohort_conclusion: Mineral Block and Mineral Lick remain distinct; Chicken Offal Dried Ground gains explicit by-product role after approval.

authority_scope: Regulated feed-material names and process-qualified products
use_for: Product identity, process qualifiers, and whole-milk/feed-material boundary checks
cohort_conclusion: Use as supporting product-language authority while keeping ontology axes relation-based and jurisdiction-neutral.
